title: Niş Modül 1. Dilim — Uygulama Planı
summary: Implementation plan for linking tasks to clients and projects: new clients/projects tables, sync merge, UI, feature-flagged.
notes: Implementation plan, not a decision record. Dominant signals are technical contracts: schema constraints (Postgres 15+, composite FK, no unique constraint), name-length limits, file structure, sync ordering → SPEC. Competing DOC signal (task checklist / execution guide) and one ADR-like section ('Spec'ten Sapma' justifying mergeNamed) are secondary; ADR precedence rule not applied because no Status field and the deviation is presented for approval, not accepted.
